name: @code-id-labs/code-chucker
description: Vite / weapp-vite build plugin for miniapp-chucker — injects the Chucker network & native inspector into weapp-vite Mini Program projects

scripts.postbuild: node ../../scripts/copy.js ../miniapp-plugin-chucker/src/components/chucker-float dist/components/chucker-float ../miniapp-plugin-chucker/src/pages/chucker dist/pages/chucker && node ../../scripts/minify.js dist && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.mjs','import m from \'./index.js\';export const chuckerPlugin=m.chuckerPlugin;export default m.default;\n');fs.writeFileSync('dist/runtime.mjs','import m from \'./runtime.js\';export const {initChucker,chuckerStore,generateCurl,formatJson,buildExportText}=m;export default m;\n');"
